_comment: Design REQUIREMENTS REGISTER (the WHY). Pass to the engine with --requirements requirements.json; it right-sizes the published design_blueprint so every deliverable (HLD/CRD/deck/explorer) reflects the requirements. Absent, the blueprint surfaces these as open questions rather than assuming. Only the keys below are recognised; omit any you have not gathered yet.
_comment_address_space: address_space (a supernet) UNLOCKS the candidate net-new IP plan (target_state.addressing_plan §5.3): each VLAN gets a /24 within it. vlan_zones (an explicit {VLAN-id: zone} map) additionally makes it ZONE-AWARE — one contiguous summarisable block per zone. Zones are NEVER inferred from data_classification names; supply vlan_zones to assign them.

requirements.growth_horizon: 3 years, +50% access ports, new DC block
